long_biography.plain_text:
Mantegazza & Cattaneo placed Geo Mantegazza at the centre of Lugano's postwar development. The civil-engineering practice handled public and private construction, then specialised in water treatment and helped deliver sanitation infrastructure around Lake Lugano. That work joined technical design to durable civic infrastructure.

Property became his principal business focus as he developed prominent city buildings and a family real-estate platform. In parallel, he led HC Lugano from the second division to national prominence. His presidency introduced a more professional model, secured promotion to the top league and produced four Swiss championships before his 1991 departure.

uncertainties.topic: Geo, Sergio and the travel business
uncertainties.detail: Forbes profiles Sergio Mantegazza & family, not Geo. Geo began in the family coach business and participated in later tourism and aviation ventures, but strong sources consistently associate Sergio with leadership of Globus and Geo principally with engineering and real estate. The dossier preserves that distinction.

The public record establishes a valuable family travel platform and Geo's separately founded engineering and real-estate business, but it does not document the timing or size of any formal inheritance. Mixed therefore describes two material mechanisms without asserting an unverified inherited stake.

No authoritative public source provides a sector-by-sector asset breakdown. RSI says Geo was principally active in real estate, the official family property history traces that business to his firm, and BILANZ identifies both property and tourism at family level; Real Estate is therefore the best-supported personal primary industry.

The official property history says Vicky Mantegazza became president in 2012, before Geo's death. Founder describes Geo's durable relationship to the platform rather than claiming current control, and no present family share allocation is inferred.

The immutable record uses the full form Geo Angelo Mantegazza, while authoritative public coverage normally uses Geo Mantegazza. The exact birth date, nationality, family, engineering history and sporting record make the identity match conclusive.

The immutable record gives Monaco as the main residence and Switzerland as the birth country. Sources establish birth in Lugano and describe him as originally from Mendrisio; the dossier treats Lugano as birthplace and does not overwrite the existing residence.

No identity-secure personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X or personal website met the proposal threshold. The official family property history is proposed as a Company Website because it directly documents the business he founded.

Both biographies omit vessel facts, asset values, net worth, rankings, property valuations, sensitive private family detail, past crimes against him, politics, allegations, controversies and legal matters.
